claim_under_pricing: C5: under large vehicle dispersion x limit-regime tasks, RL beats a fixed reflex controller and beats a classical identify-then-tune scheme. This measurement prices the prize with zero training: fixed-reflex degradation under dispersion, classical (RLS kappa identify + frozen tuning map) recovery, and the per-vehicle-tuned upper bound. prize = pertuned - fixed; classical residual = pertuned - rls.
design_probe_disclosure: Task-geometry and knob-sensitivity probes were run on seed streams 5000000-5900000 (disjoint from all selection/validation streams below) before freezing this file. Probes informed: (a) curvature-compensated on-path obstacle placement (family-1 tangent placement leaves most obstacles 7-31 m off the driving line, making labels vacuous), (b) move of both task surfaces to the R=60 arc (the R=18 friction-capped speed makes avoidance self-similar in mu and hides obstacles outside the v4 lateral window), (c) the 27-point tuning grid axes. No selection or validation seed below was rolled out before freezing.

seed_discipline.selection_eval_seed: 6000000 + L*200000 + S*100000 + v*5000 + k*13 (k = scan index, scanned until n_sel admitted rows)
seed_discipline.disjointness: selection stream lives in [6000000, 7000000), validation in [7000000, 8000000); asserted disjoint at runtime; both disjoint from prior-study panels (401500/501500/601500 bases) and from the design-probe streams (5xxxxxx).

S3_adversarial_corner.note: co-directional worst corner of S2 (heavy + weak brake + weak drive + soft tire + slow actuator), jittered so the 12 instances are distinct

shared.track: circle R=60 m, width 5 m, mu uniform [0.25,1.15] per episode, entry speed friction-capped at 0.92*sqrt(mu*g*R), friction_step disabled, max_steps 480, finish_on_pass true
shared.obstacle_placement: curvature-compensated onto the centerline arc: for target arc distance s, distance_range pinned to R*sin(s/R) and lateral_offset_range pinned to R*(1-cos(s/R)) toward the circle center (family-2 style); per-row pinned (v, mu, s, half_width)

T_limit.admission: generator label in {aeb_feasible, aes_feasible} AND per-instance adjusted label in {aeb, aes, drift} where adjusted model uses d_eff=16.0 m and a_brake_eff = min(0.9*mu*g, 6000*brake_scale/(1450*mass_scale)); lateral capacities unchanged (mass-free)

arms.fixed_v4_incumbent: M3105 ActiveSafetyReflexDriver verbatim (V4_POLICY_CONFIG); secondary arm: measures family-transfer degradation, not criterial
arms.fixed_star: one fixed config = argmax over the 27-point grid of pooled S0 selection success (both surfaces, 12x6x2=144 rows); frozen across all cells; PRIMARY fixed floor (the claim's 'fixed reflex' must be tuned once for the family at nominal, else the prize conflates family mistuning with dispersion)
arms.v4_rls: 5 s sub-limit familiarization prefix on an obstacle-free R=600 straight-arc env (same vehicle instance, mu drawn by prefix seed from the standard domain), VehicleRLS (belief-decomposition machinery) identifies kappa_b/kappa_d; frozen kappa map applied to the fixed_star config
arms.v4_pertuned: per (level, surface, instance): winner of the 27-point grid on the 6 selection rows; validated on fresh validation rows; the per-vehicle tuning upper bound at grid resolution
arms.oracle: per validation row: reveal-constrained privileged search (fixed_star closed-loop prefix to the empirical reveal step, then 15 structured open-loop candidates with early stop, then CEM pop 20/elites 5/iters 5/segments 10x8 steps, early stop on first success); defines causal solvability

tuning_grid_27.selection_tiebreak: higher sel success, then fewer (collision+offtrack) on sel rows, then fewer multipliers != 1, then lower grid index

rls_kappa_map_frozen.estimands: kappa_b = brake_scale/mass_scale, kappa_d = drive_scale/mass_scale (the only vehicle quantities this controller family consumes; selfid-belief-decomposition-2026-06)

map.brake_gains: x clip(1/kappa_b_hat, 0.5, 2.4) on the same 5 brake gains as the grid

rls_kappa_map_frozen.not_scaled: steer gains and all other parameters (kappa carries no stiffness/tau information; a stiffness-aware classical arm is declared out of scope and listed as follow-up)

denominator_rule: PRIMARY: per-cell rates computed only on validation rows the oracle solves (unavoidable rows cannot enter the denominator - M3082/M3105 lesson). SECONDARY: unfiltered rates also reported. The oracle arm equals 1.0 on the filtered denominator by construction; its unfiltered rate is the cell's causal solvability.

preregistered_readouts.uncertainty: Wilson 95% CI per arm; episode-paired bootstrap (2000 resamples) CI95 for differences (primary); Newcombe MOVER CI also reported
preregistered_readouts.c5_decision_rule: C5 stands iff >=2 of the 8 cells have primary_prize >= 0.15 with paired-bootstrap CI95 lower bound > 0 AND classical_residual >= 0.08 in those same cells; otherwise C5 fails its own bar and is reported as such
auxiliary_outputs: fixed_star and fixed_v4_incumbent success vs dispersion level per surface (degradation curves)
failure-mode composition (collision/offtrack/speed_too_low/timeout-other) per arm per cell
kappa_b/kappa_d identification error distribution of the RLS prefixes

budget_and_trim_rule: estimated ~40k episodes (~20-30 min CPU). If projected wall time exceeds 2.5 h, trim S3 from 12 to 8 instances; never trim validation seeds per instance.
runtime_gates: composed v2+v4 action function must equal the canonical M3105 v4 function exactly on 200 random observations
selection and validation eval-seed sets disjoint (asserted)
light rollout outcome must match run_episode_with_policy outcome on 12 sampled rows
RLS prefix peak rear utilization (truth frame, harness-only readout) < 0.6
claim_boundary: Feasibility-audit pricing measurement only: scripted reflex controllers, an RLS identification arm, a grid-tuned upper bound, and a privileged oracle are compared on a vehicle-randomized variant of the obstacle family. Zero training. No driver promotion, repair-success, gate-validity, paper, or self-ID capability claim. RL is never run; the 'RL prize' is an upper-bound price computed from scripted arms.
env_expressiveness_limits_declared: tanh tire curve fixed; no load transfer; no wheel lockup; 'season/modification' heterogeneity only via mass/brake/drive/stiffness/tau scale parameters; cg shift and inertia held nominal
entry speed friction-capped by the curve-holding limit (couples mu and speed; limits '速度上探' to ~22 m/s at mu=1.15 on R=60)

family-1 tangent obstacle placement is geometrically off-path on curved tracks; C5 uses compensated placement and is therefore a NEW task family (C5-F1) - incumbent v4 numbers on it measure transfer, not the M3105 panel
classical arm is kappa-only by design freeze; a stiffness/tau-aware classical arm is future work
